source_request_text: /rendezvous The target is in a circular Earth orbit at 400 km altitude (R_earth = 6378.137 km, mu = 398600.4418 km^3/s^2). Use right-handed LVLH/RIC: x radial outward, y along-track, z orbit-normal. At t = 0, the chaser state is [0, 10000, 0] m and [0, 0, 0] m/s. Use two impulsive burns to reach zero relative position and velocity; evaluate 15 equally spaced transfer times from 0.1 through 5 orbital periods, report the least total delta-v, and plot delta-v versus time.
